item.title: Grant Backs Calls for North End Shinty to Play in National Finals
item.description: A Skye primary school team has been ruled out of the National First Shinty Finals after a late rule change, with Rhoda Grant urging the Camanachd Association to reconsider the decision ahead of 28th of February.The post Grant Backs Calls for North End Shinty to Play in National Finals appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: £620,000 Boost Announced for Gaelic Broadcasting and Education
item.description: A £620,000 funding package has been announced to support Gaelic broadcasting, education and cultural projects, including new episodes of An t Eilean and improvements at Sabhal Mòr Ostaig.The post £620,000 Boost Announced for Gaelic Broadcasting and Education appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Harvie Says Reform Tax Plans Would Benefit The Super Rich
item.description: Patrick Harvie has criticised Reform’s tax plans ahead of May’s election, arguing the proposals would deliver the biggest gains to millionaires rather than to low and middle income households.The post Harvie Says Reform Tax Plans Would Benefit The Super Rich appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Traditional Cottage With Garden and Byre in Port Appin
item.description: Set in the sought after coastal village of Port Appin, Rowan Cottage is a three bedroom detached home with mature gardens and attached stone byre, offering character, flexibility and easy access to Loch Linnhe and the West Highlands.The post A Traditional Cottage With Garden and Byre in Port Appin appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Digital Ferry Vouchers Open for Orkney Residents From 15th of March
item.description: Eligible Orkney residents can download digital ferry vouchers from 15th of March, allowing free foot passenger travel to the mainland or Shetland between 1st of April 2026 and 31st of March 2027. The post Digital Ferry Vouchers Open for Orkney Residents From 15th of March appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Walk in GP Clinic Confirmed for Moray This Summer
item.description: A new walk in GP clinic will open in Moray this summer, offering on the day care from 12pm to 8pm and forming part of a national expansion expected to deliver over one million additional appointments.The post New Walk in GP Clinic Confirmed for Moray This Summer appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Maree Todd Urges Jamie Stone to Back Rural Banking Hub Petition
item.description: Maree Todd has urged Jamie Stone to back her petition seeking reform of banking hub rules, arguing rural communities across the Highlands risk financial exclusion under current criteria.The post Maree Todd Urges Jamie Stone to Back Rural Banking Hub Petition appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Committee Warns Cairngorm Funicular Costs May Outweigh Benefits
item.description: A Scottish Parliament committee has warned that the ongoing costs of the Cairngorm Funicular may outweigh its economic benefits, calling for greater transparency and clearer governance of the publicly funded project.The post Committee Warns Cairngorm Funicular Costs May Outweigh Benefits appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Historic 300 Year Old Clachaig Inn in Glencoe Goes on The Market
item.description: The 300 year old Clachaig Inn in Glencoe has been placed on the market for £3,800,000, bringing to sale one of the Highlands’ most iconic and historic inns.The post Historic 300 Year Old Clachaig Inn in Glencoe Goes on The Market appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Liberal Democrats Launch Fix Our Highland Roads Campaign
item.description: Highland Liberal Democrats have launched a petition calling for a dedicated roads funding plan after councillors were told the region faces a £233 million repair backlog.The post Highland Liberal Democrats Launch Fix Our Highland Roads Campaign appeared first on The Highland Times.
